sections: S&P weekly chart – Inverted hammer with a heavy close. Higher high failed to "breakout" over prior weeks highs. Downside gap close is likely on the table ~567.75.

S&P daily chart – Price rejected the overhead supply level. Friday's gap fill reversal keeps the pressure on to the downside however the base case remains; This is a reasonable spot for a daily higher low at the top of the China gap and daily 200SMA, pulling back from the highest high.
S&P hourly chart – 577 holds the key early in the week. If we can see an hourly trend change, I want to be thinking longs with respect to the daily higher low.
Market internals – Sellers had The Gift™®© on Friday's gap down. Price lower on a catalyst. The question becomes: Did strong sellers step up at the exchange level to take advantage of this?

Market profile – After Wednesday's bond auction mishap, price (and value) never returned above the single prints. Friday does have a decent excess low, but until value can move higher, bears have the edge. Tuesday's value will be a big tell.
